parts.text:
I'm putting together a made-up status card without tools, using the Badge, Callout, and Table tags and keeping it brief. The reply should open with the §2§ marker, and I'm drafting the badge line now.

Still writing the status card layout...

Here is the made-up status card for the three pretend services.

<Badge tone="warning">1 of 3 up</Badge>

<Callout title="beta is degraded" tone="warning">
Latency on beta rose to 840 ms. A cache restart is planned for this evening.
</Callout>

<Table data={[{service: "alpha", state: "up", latency: "120 ms"}, {service: "beta", state: "degraded", latency: "840 ms"}, {service: "gamma", state: "down", latency: "n/a"}]} columns={["service", "state", "latency"]} />
